name: Magical Illusion
original_name: マジカルイリュージョン
source: A short adventure game featuring the two heroines, Setsuna and Kokona, where the player can choose between the "Lovey-Dovey Route" where he saves the two and has a loving sex time together or the "Evil Route" where he does the exact opposite.
translation: 这是一款以两位女主人公刹那和心菜为主角的短篇冒险游戏，玩家可以选择拯救两人并享受爱情时光的“情爱路线”，也可以选择相反的“邪恶路线”。
